stock.description: MemeStrategy, Inc., an investment holding company, provides data transmission and processing services for IOT applications in Mainland China and internationally. The company provides telecommunication equipment, such as IoT antennas, vehicle mounted antennas, and 5G telecommunication equipment services, as well as telecommunication equipment maintenance and telecommunication consulting services. It serves customers in manufacturing, municipal, transportation, environmental protection, energy, and other industries. The company was formerly known as Howkingtech International Holding Limited and changed its name to MemeStrategy, Inc. in May 2025. MemeStrategy, Inc. was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Nanjing, the People's Republic of China. MemeStrategy, Inc. is a subsidiary of Howkingtech Holding Limited.
